description: This file defines the PackageNamePicker class, which extends PickerActivity and provides functionality to retrieve a list of package names installed on an Android device using the dumpsys command with sed and sort commands.

classes.name: PackageNamePicker
classes.description: A class extending PickerActivity that executes a command to fetch and process package names from the device.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Overridden method that runs a shell command to retrieve and return a list of package names, handling timeout and exceptions.
